div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.twiin.nl/ig/workflow/CodeSystem/ta-workflow defines the following codes:

tr.td: The Multiple Fulfillers Pattern applies and no candidate has been selected yet; the owner is invited to accept and, optionally, to bid, and may not yet start the work.
The Placer has selected the owner of this Task as the Fulfiller.
The Placer has selected another candidate; the Coordination Task of this candidate is cancelled.
The entry carries the type of work.
The entry refers, in valueReference, to one resource at the Placer that the Fulfiller may read beyond the standard dataset.
The entry carries, in valueString, a search relative to the FHIR base of the Placer that the Fulfiller may perform beyond the standard dataset.

description.value: Codes defined by TA Workflow for Task.code, Task.businessStatus, Task.statusReason and Task.input.type.
